note: Cost table of the Mars cap at draft (scratch switches, no commit): of 23.5 s at 2464 the cap is 17.4 s: 7.1 s triangles (5.7 million for 2.0 million pixels), 1.1 s height reads, 8.0 s the 8 colour levels per pixel, 1.2 s the rest per pixel. Not reading colour levels whose value is multiplied by 0 left every PNG byte in place (12 of 12) and took 1.9 to 7.2 s off.
